title: White Knight Chronicles II

progress_reporting.current_milestone: Live WKC1 town with improved NPC surfaces after NV0039 transfers; short movement and camera response rechecked

native_continuous_movie_playback_scope: LPCM startup logos, AC-3 title background and observed attract-movie playback
native_dynamic_text_rendering_scope: New Game description, game-selection dialog and confirmation

long_term_objectives: Provide English translations for Japanese-exclusive content

native_avatar_customization_ui_scope: WKC1 selection reaches Customize Avatar; controller input dismisses the introductory notice
development_priority: Baseline 01.00 native 3D rendering and gameplay, starting with White Knight Chronicles I
native_character_creation_room_rendering: WKC1 Customize Avatar room visible with normal guest depth testing and culling
native_avatar_body_geometry_scope: WKC1 Customize Avatar body, including arms, hands, trousers and boots; normal depth/culling
native_avatar_model_rendering_scope: Observed WKC1 default male avatar in Customize Avatar; full body, face and clothing visible with normal depth/culling

planned_text_entry.input: gamepad navigation, editing, acceptance and cancellation

native_character_name_entry_scope: Windows editor and guest ABI tested; native WKC1 retains the entered test name through Quick Start to final Review and start-game confirmation
native_avatar_acceptance_and_opening_mov: Fresh PPU/SPU code; confirms avatar and plays the prerecorded WKC1 opening movie. Later live town rendering and limited controls are verified separately.

renderers.future_apple_silicon: Metal shared RSX draw engine; untested
renderers.future_linux: Vulkan; platform integration and execution untested

cpu_execution.mode: Ahead-of-time PPU/SPU recompilation with PS3 compatibility runtime and observed SPU interpreter fallback
cpu_execution.remaining_requirement: Cover missing SPU entries and any runtime-generated code with validated static/native implementations, then measure fallback coverage across gameplay.

native_character_creation_completed_scop: Default male avatar named and accepted through Quick Start; opening cutscenes advance to the town. Full visual fidelity and all customization options are not verified.
native_wkc1_town_world_view_scope: Live town with Leonard, NPC names, minimap and save crystal visible; NPC surface speckling improved after NV0039 support, while stretched geometry remains. Full material fidelity unverified.

spu_fallback_census.purpose: Prioritize validated static C/C++ implementations for remaining fallback paths
spu_fallback_census.baseline_comparison_method: 64-byte FNV-1a entry fingerprints; not a whole-function comparison

native_movement_and_camera_control_scope: Short starting-town movement, facing/walking animation, minimap position change and camera rotation; sustained traversal, combat and save/load unverified.

graphics_copy_research.next_fix: Investigate remaining stretched geometry, including SPU skinning output; full material fidelity remains unverified
graphics_copy_research.nv0039_scope: Non-notifying byte transfers; signed/zero pitches, strides 1/2/4, overlap, MAIN mappings and shared-renderer RGBA8 coherence. Notification completion and other GPU layouts remain limited.
graphics_copy_research.nv0039_improvement_scope: Previously speckled/mosaic NPC surfaces look coherent in the inspected starting-town readbacks after short movement and camera rotation. Qualitative comparison with earlier 42/51-patch captures, not proof of full material fidelity.
